# Flat Rate Scheme or standard VAT: which leaves you more?

> Free UK VAT Flat Rate Scheme calculator: compare the flat rate for your trade, the 16.5% limited cost trader rate and the 1% first-year discount with standard VAT accounting and see which leaves you more. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
